transcript.text: The title is fixed, but the legend is still wrong, as the render shows. Passing a bare label list to `plt.legend` also hands labels to seaborn's confidence-band patches, which are the Rectangle handles behind the error. So 'Transportation' landed on the orange Public_Health line, and patches took the other slots. The fix is to build the legend from the line handles seaborn has already labeled correctly, via `ax.get_legend_handles_labels()`. The legend title and position stay the same. I'll then verify each legend entry's color and marker against the data line it names. s = open('chart.py').read() s = s.replace("plt.legend(['Public_Education', 'Public_Health', 'Transportation', 'National_Defense', 'Social_Services', 'Environment'], title='Sector'", "handles, labels = plt.gca().get_legend_handles_labels()\nplt.legend(handles, labels, title='Sector'") with open('chart.py','w') as f: f.write(s) plt.close('all') exec(s, {}) ax = plt.gca() print(ax.get_title()) leg = ax.get_legend() lines = {l.get_color() if isinstance(l.get_color(),str) else tuple(l.get_color()): l for l in ax.get_lines()} for h, t in zip(leg.legend_handles, leg.get_texts()): c = h.get_color(); match = [list(l.get_ydata())[0] for l in ax.get_lines() if l.get_color()==c and len(l.get_ydata())==6] print(t.get_text(), c, h.get_marker(), match) continue
